changelog:
console-agent v1.2.0 released

- Introduces console.agent() for easy AI agentic workflows in JavaScript and Python, mirroring console.log() usage style.
- Adds automatic persona detection (Security, Debugger, Architect, General) and persona shortcuts for targeted analysis.
- Supports both fire-and-forget (non-blocking) and awaitable (blocking) agent runs.
- Integrates optional tools: real-time Google Search, Python code execution, and URL context analysis.
- Includes customizable configuration options: model, budget, anonymization, local/cloud mode, caller source inclusion, and more.
- Provides structured AgentResult outputs for advanced result handling and inspection.
- Covers common use cases such as security audits, debugging, data validation, and architecture review.
